question: Which terminal lifecycle moment should workflow integrations observe, and should that contract live only in typed plugin hooks or also in internal HOOK.md automation?
rationale: Current main has several distinct terminal moments and an already-shipped plugin finalization hook; automation cannot safely choose the meaning or add a parallel public lifecycle API without maintainer intent.

options.title: Extend plugin lifecycle
options.body: Add precise task-completion reasons and missing emitters to typed plugin hooks, then document that as the supported workflow integration contract.

options.title: Add distinct internal event
options.body: Create a separately named internal task-completion event with explicit semantics instead of overloading session finalization.

options.title: Keep finalization semantics
options.body: Keep `session_end` limited to replacement, deletion, and shutdown while using narrower subagent and cron hooks for task completion.

recommendation.title: Extend plugin lifecycle
recommendation.body: Add precise task-completion reasons and missing emitters to typed plugin hooks, then document that as the supported workflow integration contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision directly affects the typed plugin-hook contract this contributor introduced and recently maintained.
